admission.justification: The budget test checks every fresh compiled capsule, declared detail and the digest against the current record and the frozen registries; without it an overgrown capsule or a silently edited registry would break instruction composition unnoticed.

applicability: Every compiled role, operation and launcher capsule cell, every manifest-declared step detail and the shared every-role digest, as recorded in skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/capsule-budgets-current.json.
conditions: Capsule ceilings come from authored per-role values; step details use the authored shared detail ceiling and the digest uses the authored digest ceiling.
The checks compare freshly compiled sizes and source identities with generated measurements; growth under an authored ceiling has no individual item budget.
The retained registry, snapshot helper, predecessor record and predecessor helper are authenticated by their historical hashes.
exclusions: Ordinary linked templates are measured without a detail ceiling.
The digest map is renewable and is not authenticated as frozen history.
The separate handover-projection token obligation retains its own record.
A size check does not establish semantic, audience or acceptance correctness.
The frozen historical registries' cells and budget formula are not current guarantees.

evidence: capsule-sizes.json (era 62748, a1b7 109616, master 107226, final 93905); sync-check 9/9; F07 memo for launcher/orientation +57 and architect/recovery +17

statement: The current capsule-budget record holds generated measurements for every compiled capsule cell, declared step detail and shared digest; checks reject stale or missing measurements, orphan membership and growth beyond authored role, detail or digest ceilings, while frozen historical registries and their retained checkers remain authenticated.
